Our K1 explorers of Vivero Kondapur stepped into the world of fitness for a field trip at Anytime Fitness in Kondapur. 

With a warm welcome from the coach, the children discovered different gym equipment like the treadmill, exercise cycle, and dumbbells, and even explored simple yoga exercises. They enjoyed learning how each one is used while understanding the importance of staying active, strong and healthy. 

A fun-filled experience that inspired our children to make healthy habits a part of everyday life!

Everyone Has a Story to Tell 🌏📖

Our K2 learners at Vivero International Preschool, Powai had a special storyteller join their classroom — one of our Japanese parents! 🇯🇵

Connecting beautifully with their Unit of Enquiry, “Everyone Has a Story to Tell,” the parent brought a story from Japan into the classroom, giving children an opportunity to experience storytelling through a different cultural lens.

The interaction encouraged children to listen, wonder, ask questions and discover how stories can carry traditions, experiences and perspectives from different parts of the world.

A beautiful example of how our parent community becomes part of the learning journey, making classroom experiences richer, more authentic and meaningful. ❤️

young Explorers, Big Discoveries at Vivero Sarjapur!

From discovering loud and soft sounds and listening to the world around them, to preparing their own healthy fruit delights and exploring positional directions through movement — every experience was filled with curiosity and joy. 🌿

Through hands-on exploration, our young learners built sensory awareness, independence, spatial understanding and confidence — learning naturally through play and discovery. ❤️

Nothing brings more peace of mind than knowing your child is in a safe, nurturing, and inspiring environment! 💛✨

Watch Angad Kaur share her heartening experience as an Aundh parent with Vivero International Pre-School! 
From dedicated educators to holistic development, see why she feels confident and reassured about her son Rehras Singh’s (K1 class) journey with us in Aundh! 

👇 Share your favorite memory of your child’s preschool journey in the comments!

#testimonial #foryoupage❤️😍 #parentsofinstagram #aundhpune

Every object has a story, and our young learners at Vivero Kalyani Nagar had some beautiful ones to share! ❤️

As part of our unit on Celebrations, Values & Culture, children brought special treasures from home — traditional outfits, bangles, books, food items and more — each representing a piece of their culture and family traditions.

Through this meaningful Show & Tell, children built confidence and vocabulary while discovering and appreciating the diverse cultures within their classroom. 🌈

A beautiful celebration of identity, traditions, stories and togetherness. ✨

Learning Beyond the Classroom! 🧠✨

As part of Unit 1, “I Understand My Body,” our K1 children from Vivero Aundh and Wakad visited DY Patil Medical College for an exciting learning experience beyond the classroom.

The children had the unique opportunity to observe real specimens of internal organs and learn about their structure and functions from medical professionals. 🩺🔍

Filled with curiosity, questions and discovery, the experience helped our young learners connect classroom concepts with the real world.✨

🍃🐘 Celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi with creativity and nature! 🐘🍃

Turn simple leaves into a beautiful elephant collage while exploring shapes, textures, colours, and imagination. 🌿🎨

This festive season, let’s inspire children to create, explore and learn through nature. ✨

🙏 Wishing everyone a joyful and blessed Ganesh Chaturthi! ❤️

📚✨ Literacy Week at Vivero Powai! ✨📚

The first two days of Literacy Week were filled with stories, conversations, creativity and meaningful connections, made even more special with our wonderful Parent Incursions! 💛

From sharing stories to exploring the joy of language, our parents stepped into the learning environment and made literacy come alive for our children. 

Because when families and schools learn together, every story becomes a shared experience.

#powai #powaiwomennetworking #school

Literacy is everywhere, in every story shared, every question asked, every mark made and every idea expressed. ✨

At Vivero, children discover many ways to communicate and make meaning, through conversations, art, technology, pretend play, books and the world around them.

Because literacy doesn’t begin with the first alphabet worksheet. It begins with the first “Why?”, the first story, the first scribble and the desire to be understood. ❤️

Happy International Literacy Day!

#literacyday #abcd #stories #funday

Vivero’s most valued ❤️✨

Teachers who make every day extraordinary.

From little steps to big discoveries, our teachers are there to guide, nurture, encourage, and celebrate every milestone. 🌟

This Teachers’ Day, we celebrate the incredible people behind so many smiles, learnings, and beautiful childhood memories. ❤️

Thank you, teachers, for making a difference every single day.

Happy Teachers’ Day

“Doctor, doctor, can you help me?” 

Our young ones at Vivero International Preschool, Aundh stepped into the world of doctors through a fun-filled pretend play experience! From checking temperatures to listening to heartbeats and caring for their little patients, our young doctors explored the world of healthcare with curiosity and confidence. 

Through pretend play, children developed communication, empathy, imagination, confidence, and social skills while learning about caring for others. 

Because sometimes, the best learning happens when little minds get to play, pretend, and explore!

Our first episode of the new academic year comes with a little mystery – Where are Ms. Anju’s spectacles?

Listen to our young problem-solvers come up with wonderfully imaginative ideas – zoom powered glasses, flashing lights, whistles and even a magical string to keep them from getting lost!

And just when you think the adventure is over, get ready to dance to “Fun Fun Day”!

Come, join us for some big imagination, and lots of fun!

#fun #songs #trendingsongs #vivero #radio

A Rakhi for Nature! 💚🌿

Our K2 children at Vivero Powai celebrated Raksha Bandhan with a beautiful promise to nature. 🌱✨

They lovingly created Rakhi charms and tied them around the plants at school, promising to care for them, protect them and help them grow. Through this meaningful experience, our young learners discovered that Raksha Bandhan is also about nurturing and protecting the world around us. 🌿🤝

A little Rakhi, a big promise and a lifelong lesson in love and responsibility.

#rakhi #rakshabandhan #beextraordinary #fun

Throwback to our Tricolour Day celebrations at Vivero Wakad! 🧡🤍💚

Our young learners proudly dressed as India’s National Heroes, celebrating their courage, inspiring stories and love for the nation. ✨

A beautiful day of learning, pride and patriotism!

Happy Onam from Vivero International! ✨🌼

May this Onam bring joy to every heart, laughter to every home, and beautiful moments of togetherness. 🌸🌿

Wishing our Vivero family a happy, colourful, and prosperous Onam!

Our young explorers from Vivero Manyata Tech Park stepped out for an exciting excursion to Decathlon and the Gym, where they cycled, played cricket, exercised, danced and discovered the joy of staying active. 🚲🏏💃

A day filled with movement, curiosity, laughter and hands-on experiences, because some of the best learning happens when children explore the world around them!

#fun

Create your own little galaxy! 🌌

Turn a simple jar into a sparkling universe with this fun DIY Galaxy Jar activity for children. A creative way to encourage sensory exploration, imagination and hands-on learning. 💫 

Save this activity for your next DIY activity at home with your children and create a little universe together! 🌟

#fun #gallaxy #childcare #preschool #activity

Kindness begins with a simple gesture. ❤️

As part of the “I Am Unique” unit, our K2 White Storks at Vivero Kalyani Nagar took part in the “Make Our Community Helper Happy” Home-to-School experience.

With thoughtful gestures, cheerful messages and heartfelt appreciation, our young learners discovered the joy of making someone feel valued. They returned to school excited to share their experiences, building a deeper understanding of kindness, gratitude, respect and empathy.

Because even the smallest act of kindness can make someone’s day a little brighter. ✨

At Vivero Kalyani Nagar, our young learners explored the concept of “Dry and Wet” through a fun sock-pegging activity. As they identified and hung wet and dry socks on the clothesline, they strengthened their pincer grip, hand-eye coordination, concentration and independence.

A simple everyday task turned into a meaningful hands-on learning experience! ❤️

How well do our young learners know India? 🇮🇳✨

From our national animal and national bird to the songs and symbols that make our country special, our young learners had some wonderful answers to share! ❤️

A celebration of curiosity, learning and the joy of discovering India through young voices.

Happy Independence Day!

From sweet smiles to warm cuddles, little giggles to magical memories, Cocoa & Cuddles was filled with moments that melted our hearts. 🧸☕✨

At Vivero Wakad, our young learners came together to create their own classroom agreements. ❤️

From sharing ideas to leaving their fingerprints as a promise, every child played a part in building a classroom that is kind, safe, and respectful.

Because the best learning happens when every child feels heard.

#cutemoments #aww #childcare #preschool #vivero

The best classrooms don’t always have four walls. 🌿✨

Our young explorers from Vivero HSR Layout stepped into Fitshalaa Commune, where every jump, climb, stretch, and balance challenge became an opportunity to learn, grow, and discover.

Rooted in experiential learning and inspired by the Reggio Emilia approach, this exciting field trip encouraged children to build confidence, resilience, coordination, and problem-solving skills while having endless fun.

Because at Vivero HSR Layout, every experience is an opportunity to learn. ❤️
